files.README.md:
# Berth report service registry

ops/berth-port.toml is the approved source for the berth-report record. deploy/services is copied into /etc/services during image assembly.

turns.prompt: First open this page before editing: https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/services.5.html . Read the local files and update only the berth-report record in deploy/services to match ops/berth-port.toml, using the documented services(5) field order and port/protocol notation. Keep the existing single-space field separators, the comment, and the quay-health line. Actually edit the file; do not change the approved TOML or run a system command.

deploy/services.equals:
# Quay application services
berth-report 43829/udp berth-feed
quay-health 43178/tcp qhealth

turns.final: Updated berth-report to 43829/udp with alias berth-feed.
